title: Frequency Reuse Cluster Size Capacity and S I
aim: Analyze how cluster size affects co-channel reuse ratio, system capacity, and signal-to-interference ratio in a cellular system.
parameters: Valid cluster sizes from N = i^2 + i*j + j^2
method: For each valid N compute Q = sqrt(3N), channels per cell k = floor(S/N), capacity C = M*k*N, and S/I = 10 log10(Q^n/6). Find the smallest cluster meeting 18 dB.
result: The smallest cluster meeting the S/I target is N = 7, with S/I = 18.66 dB. Increasing N improves S/I while channels per cell generally decrease.
